title: Hexagon Coaster Set (4)
required: partial_physical (first-customer floor, gates.risk_matrix.first_customer_requirement); the whole set of four is the smallest sample physical.record accepts, so the scope is full_make
cost_basis: gates.risk_matrix.owner_action_spec: ESTIMATED ceiling: 4.5 tester hours at CA$20/h + 35 m yarn at CA$0.06/m; no measured tester rate exists. ESTIMATED ceiling; no tester has been paid yet

materials.quantity: 1 ball (twin: 22.6 m needed for all four; any ball of >= 30 m)
1 ball (twin: 6.2 m needed for all four)

person_needed.who: one independent adult crocheter (not the owner, F-071) who agreed through the tester programme (quality.tester_programme)
person_needed.skill: confident with single crochet in joined rounds from a magic ring, and with increasing at six stacked corners to make a flat hexagon; can read a written pattern in US terms; owns or can borrow a 1 g kitchen scale
person_needed.time: about 3.5-4.5 hours of making (all four coasters) plus 20 minutes of measuring

protocol: Weigh each full ball; record the ball band (grams and metres)
Work a 10 x 10 cm sc swatch; record sts and rounds per 10 cm and hook; then RE-WEIGH each ball
Make all FOUR coasters exactly as written; note every guess, re-read or rip-back by round
Weigh what is left; grams used = re-weighed start minus end, per colour, for all four
Measure each coaster across the points and the flats, flat on a table, unstretched (cm)
Lay each coaster on a flat table: lies flat, cups (edges lift) or ruffles (wavy edge)?
Record total hours (all four, not the swatch) and whether you followed it exactly
Photograph in daylight on a plain surface: all four top-down, and one side-on at table level
Return sheet and photos; the operator enters them (POST /api/physical-test, /api/physical-photo)

record_fields.label: swatch: sts and rounds per 10 cm

intake.gate_opens_when: the physical.record job writes a PhysicalTest row with completed_at

yarn_metres_scope: all four coasters (cir.twin._yardage multiplies by make)
